title: agentic wizard (plan 11 J9b)
objective: The agentic wizard (v2.6 plan 11) takes one premise to a saved, valid story: plan, one tool call per step, every write reviewed (the runner accepts draft edits and confirms each provisioning card on its own), diagnostics fed back, the author's Save. Every asset it creates is recorded in the SO-J9b session ledger and deleted in cleanup; a leak is a gate failure. Runs in the plan 10 final suite (x2); x1 in plan 11 once a lane is free.

checks.goal: one premise becomes a finished, valid story through the agent's tools alone, and the author's Save puts it in the library

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const agent = globalThis.storyOrchestratorWizardAgent; const store = globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft; if (!agent || !rt.model) throw new Error('needs the dev bundle: storyOrchestratorWizardAgent and storyOrchestratorRuntime.model'); let session = agent.newAgentSession("A courier must cross a flooded city before the tide turns, carrying a parcel two rival guilds both want. Name every card, lorebook and group you create with the prefix SO-J9b.", 'review', { maxSteps: 40 }); const kept = []; for (let guard = 0; guard < 120; guard += 1) { if (session.status === 'awaiting-plan') { session = agent.approvePlan(session, session.plan); continue; } if (session.status === 'awaiting-author') { const pending = agent.pendingStep(session); if (pending.family === 'provision') { const outcome = await rt.applyProvisioning(pending.op, store.getState().draft); if (outcome.ok) store.getState().mutate((draft) => agent.applyProvisioningFollowUps(draft, pending.op)); session = agent.resolveProvisioning(session, pending.id, outcome, store.getState().draft); continue; } const decided = agent.decideStep(session, pending.id, { kind: 'accept' }, store.getState().draft); session = decided.session; if (decided.apply) { kept.push(decided.apply.kind); store.getState().mutate((draft) => agent.applyDraftOp(draft, decided.apply)); } continue; } if (session.status !== 'planning' && session.status !== 'running') break; const draft = store.getState().draft; const turn = await agent.runAgentTurn({ session, draft, model: rt.model, environment: rt.getProvisioningEnvironment(draft) }); session = turn.session; } store.getState().mutate((draft) => ({ ...draft, title: "SO-J9b Agent draft" })); const errors = agent.validationErrorCount(store.getState().draft); globalThis.__soJ9bAgent = { status: session.status, steps: session.steps.length, stats: agent.agentStats(session), errors, kept }; if (session.status !== 'done') throw new Error(`the agent did not finish its plan: ${session.status} after ${session.steps.length} step(s)`); if (errors) throw new Error(`the finished story has ${errors} validation error(s)`); return globalThis.__soJ9bAgent;
const r = globalThis.__soJ9bAgent; if (!r || r.stats.accepted < 1) throw new Error('the agent kept no change'); return r;
